description: Managed device driver for the Renkus-Heinz Iconyx.
author: symetrix

notes: New standard panel: Renkus-Heinz header, stock Cognio controls.
Online the driver always connects; offline (designing in Cognio) it only talks to the speaker while Connect Offline is on.
Connected lights only after the speaker answers; a speaker that misses two replies is dropped and retried. The Aux 2 serial number field no longer shows the master MAC address.
